description: This file defines an interface for providing adapters related to acknowledgements within the Ditto protocol adapter. It specifies methods to retrieve adapters for individual acknowledgements and collections of acknowledgements.

classes.name: AcknowledgementAdapterProvider
classes.description: An interface that provides methods to access adapters for acknowledgements and acknowledgements collections.

methods.name: getAcknowledgementAdapter
methods.description: Returns an adapter for Acknowledgement types.

methods.name: getAcknowledgementsAdapter
methods.description: Returns an adapter for Acknowledgements collection types.
